title: Abelian Ext map in the common section-complex diagram
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X -> Y [def-pc-scheme], module F on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], any identity h-map resolution data D=(I,J,K,lambda,beta,a) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], and natural degree p, let bI,bJ be the explicit abelianResolutionIso of [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization]. Let v be exact inverse image on abelian Ext followed by coeff(f,identity), with constIso(f).symm [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Then bJ followed by H(section(beta)) equals v followed by bI and H(a followed by section(lambda)), as morphisms into H(section(K)). This is an equality of abelian Ext/section homology maps. It contains neither the fixed module/Ext equivalence nor the module edge map and does not assume acyclicity of f_*F.

theorem abelianEdge_section_diagram {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : X.Modules)
    (D : ModuleCohomologyFMapData f ((pushforward f).obj F) F
      (𝟙 ((pushforward f).obj F))) (p : ℕ) :
    (abelianResolutionIso Y D.J p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.β) =
      abelianEdgeHom f F p ≫ (abelianResolutionIso X D.I p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (D.a.hom ≫
            ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map D.lambda)
